products.title: Oteco 90° Long-Sweep Ells with 2" Outlet, 4 in, 5 in
products.focusKeyword: oteco 90° long sweep ell with 2 inch outlet
products.descriptionShort: Oteco 90° long sweep ell with 2 inch outlet manifold fittings, 4", 5", 3,000 to 5,000 psi, with line pipe, butt-weld Sch. 80 to XXS and special ends, standard and sour gas — 10 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco 90° long sweep ell with 2 inch outlet is a 90° long-radius elbow with a 2-inch outlet for a gauge, a bleed-off or a fill line. Long-sweep manifold fittings keep abrasive drilling mud flowing through the pump discharge, standpipe and choke and kill manifolds with less erosion and pressure loss than short-radius fittings.

Oteco manifold fittings are castings — ASTM A216 Grade WCC for the 2- to 5-inch 5,000 psi fittings, A487 Grade 4D modified for the 5-inch 7,500 and 8,000 psi extra-heavy-wall fittings — machined in single chuckings on horizontal machining centres and hydrostatically tested to at least 1-1/2 times working pressure. Butt-weld ends have a 37.5° bevel and match ASME B36.10 OD and ID; line-pipe threads are cut in the 2-, 3- and 4-inch sizes. Sour gas service is available on all fittings, and material tensile and chemical certification on request.

products.title: OTECO Connector — Hub and Clamp Connector, 1" to 12"
products.descriptionShort: The OTECO hub-and-clamp connector, interchangeable with Grayloc clamp connectors: standard sizes 1" to 12" and heavy-duty sizes B to F, standard and sour gas. Authorised Oteco distributor; enquire with size and rating.
products.descriptionLong:
The OTECO Connector does the job of a high-pressure flanged joint in less space and weight. Two hubs take the place of the flanges, a clamp takes the place of the flange bolts, and a seal ring is the gasket. It is used where conditions are hard on a flange: corrosive or hazardous fluids, high temperatures and cryogenic service.

  • Standard sizes 1 in to 12 in, heavy-duty sizes B to F.
  • Much smaller and lighter than an equivalent flanged connection, and quicker to make up and break out.
  • Components machined from certifiable materials, for standard and sour gas service.
  • Oteco states that the connector is interchangeable with Grayloc clamp connectors. Grayloc is a trademark of its owner.

Quoted to order: send the size or hub designation, the pressure and temperature, the service, the hub end preparation and the materials, and we return Oteco's offer.
